cimgroup-cimgroup:lever:766d801b-ab57-4d.title: Executive Assistant
cimgroup-cimgroup:lever:766d801b-ab57-4d.description: ABOUT CIM GROUP: CIM is a community-focused real estate and infrastructure owner, operator, lender, and developer. Our team of experts works together to identify and create value in real assets, benefiting the communities in which we invest. Back in 1994, our three founders focused on projects in Southern California neighborhoods. Today, we are a diverse team of 900+ employees with projects across the Americas. Our projects have delivered jobs; created comfortable places to live, work, and relax; and provided necessary and sustainable infrastructure. Our focus on enhancing communities is unwavering, and we strive to make an even greater impact in the years to come. Join us and make an impact today! POSITION PURPOSE: The Executive Assistant provides high-volume, high-priority support to a fast-paced senior executive and a team of senior leadership professionals. This role serves as a trusted partner, enabling leadership to operate efficiently by managing complex logistics, anticipating needs, and ensuring seamless coordination across internal and external stakeholders. The ideal candidate is highly organized, proactive, discreet, and thrives in a fast-paced, client-facing environment.
responsibilities: Provide comprehensive administrative support to a top-level executive and multiple senior leaders, including calendar management (across multiple time zones), meeting coordination, and travel planning.
Proactively manage and prioritize competing demands, ensuring leaders are prepared for meetings, presentations, and key engagements.
Arrange detailed domestic travel itineraries, including flights, accommodations, and logistics; anticipating travel needs and proactively adjust plans as business priorities shift.
Mange the coordination of meetings including technology and refreshment set-up, preparation of meeting materials (e.g. agenda and presentation), etc.
Set-up and maintain departmental and/or management files according to established criteria.
Event planning responsibilities including but not limited to; planning corporate events, and booking related travel.

Prepare and process expense reports. Reconcile charges to Corporate and/or business credit card(s) and review, approve, code, and process invoices related to departmental expenses including but not limited to:  setting up vendors, ensuring appropriate insurance coverage is obtained and submitted, and tracking payments to ensure timely payments.
Serve as a reliable point of contact between executives, internal teams, and external partners.
Handle sensitive and confidential information with the highest level of discretion.
Performs other duties, including special projects, as assigned.
qualifications: Bachelor’s degree and/or related experience preferred.
5-10 years of experience in an administrative assistant role.
Experience supporting multiple executives simultaneously, with demonstrated ability to prioritize competing demands, preferably within fast-paced environment.
Proven ability to manage complex calendars and logistics at an executive level.
Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office including Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint required.
Experience with video conferencing software is preferred.
Experience with accounts payable software desirable.
Experience with office equipment such as printers, copiers, scanners, mail metering machines.
Exercises sound judgment and discretion, making timely, well-informed decisions to resolve issues and navigate competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Exhibits a strong ownership mindset, consistently responding to requests with urgency and accountability while ensuring tasks and deliverables are completed accurately and on time.
Maintains a professional, polished presence, serving as a trusted representative of senior leadership and positively reflecting the organization in all interactions.
Communicates with clarity and confidence, effectively engaging with stakeholders across all levels of the organization, including senior executives, external partners, and boards of directors.
Handles sensitive and confidential matters with discretion and tact, responding thoughtfully and effectively to complex or high-stakes inquiries and concerns.
Demonstrates strong business acumen.

cimgroup-cimgroup:lever:873cea2c-a720-4e.title: Coordinator, Valuation
cimgroup-cimgroup:lever:873cea2c-a720-4e.description: ABOUT CIM GROUP: CIM is a community-focused real estate and infrastructure owner, operator, lender, and developer. Our team of experts works together to identify and create value in real assets, benefiting the communities in which we invest. Back in 1994, our three founders focused on projects in Southern California neighborhoods. Today, we are a diverse team of 900+ employees with projects across the Americas. Our projects have delivered jobs; created comfortable places to live, work, and relax; and provided necessary and sustainable infrastructure. Our focus on enhancing communities is unwavering, and we strive to make an even greater impact in the years to come. Join us and make an impact today! POSITION PURPOSE: The Coordinator, Valuation supports the appraisal process by coordinating data collection, managing appraiser and internal review workflows, and ensuring timely, accurate delivery of appraisal materials. This role works closely with Accounting, Portfolio Oversight, Investments, and Property Management teams, as well as external appraisers, to track deadlines, review reports for accuracy, and maintain organized documentation. In addition, the Coordinator provides general administrative support and assists with ad-hoc and miscellaneous tasks to support the operation of the Valuation team. This position requires strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a deadline-driven environment.
responsibilities: Coordinate the transmission of supporting data from CIM to external appraisers.
Request, assemble, and organize appraisal support materials, including rent rolls, income statements, budgets, lease agreements, construction costs, project timelines, etc. for the appraisal process.
Upload and manage assembled information to ShareFile folder or other designated platforms for appraiser access.
Track, manage and prioritize appraiser information requests to ensure responsiveness and adherence to deadlines.
Monitor appraisal timelines and due dates; log  appraisal draft reports into the appraisal valuation trackers.
Distribute draft appraisal reports to the appropriate CIM review team members and coordinate review process.
Follow up with internal review teams to ensure review comments are received by established deadlines.
Review draft appraisal reports for mathematical accuracy and narrative consistency. Identify and flag significant variances.
Assist with verification and reconciliation of accounting data within appraisal reports, including construction costs, remaining balances, condominium unit sales, and historical financials.
Request, review and upload final appraisal reports to ShareFile upon completion of the deadline.
Prepare meeting agendas and drafting and finalizing meeting minutes.
Prepare and coordinate execution of contract approval forms, engagement letters, not reliance letters and related documentation.
Coordinate and schedule meetings and site inspections.
Track and review vendor invoices for accuracy and ensure timely payment.
Distribute miscellaneous correspondences to CIM team members.
Provide general administrative support, including assistance with the property tax appeal process and preparing special reports when required.
qualifications: Bachelor’s degree from an accredited university (in Business, preferred).
2-5 years prior experience working within the Real Estate industry in an accounting or finance role.
Proficient with Microsoft Office including Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams required.
Willingness to learn new software tools such as Argus, Yardi, and SharePoint.
Ability to independently organize, prioritize and manage multiple tasks, including repetitive processes, in a detailed and deadline-oriented environment.
Proven ability to deliver timely, accurate work under pressure.
Ability to review, interpret, and reconcile financial and supporting documentation.
Proactive in identifying potential delays or issues and resolving them independently.
Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to apply practical, common-sense judgment.
Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Comfortable working cross-functionally with internal teams and external service providers.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:9e194216-717d-.title: Google Cloud Delivery Architect
jobgether-jobgether:lever:9e194216-717d-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Google Cloud Delivery Architect based in France. This is a senior, hands-on cloud architecture role focused on delivering complex Google Cloud engagements from design through implementation and handover. You will take ownership of scoped, fixed-budget projects and translate customer requirements into reliable production environments. The role combines cloud architecture, infrastructure as code, Kubernetes, networking, security, and DevOps expertise. You will work directly with customers, lead technical discussions, and manage several engagements in parallel. You’ll also drive cloud migrations, establish secure landing zones, and modernize infrastructure through automation and GitOps. This is an opportunity to make a direct impact on enterprise cloud transformation while operating with significant technical and delivery ownership. Own the end-to-end delivery of Google Cloud engagements, from low-level design and implementation through validation, documentation, knowledge transfer, and final handover. Design and execute cloud migrations from AWS or Azure to Google Cloud, including production workloads such as EKS to GKE, RDS to Cloud SQL, and S3 to Cloud Storage. Design and implement secure Google Cloud foundations and landing zones covering resource hierarchies, IAM, organization policies, networking, and security controls, with infrastructure codified in Terraform. Architect and deploy production-grade GKE environments, including private clusters, node pools, Workload Identity, Helm-based add-ons, ingress, autoscaling, and Cloud Armor. Enable DevOps and infrastructure automation by importing existing environments into Terraform, developing reusable modules, and implementing CI/CD and GitOps workflows using tools such as GitHub Actions and Argo CD. Manage multiple customer engagements simultaneously, maintaining delivery plans, project hours, scope, budgets, and timelines while identifying risks and budget deviations early. Lead customer-facing workshops, weekly meetings, technical discussions, and handover sessions with engineering teams, technical leaders, and CTO-level stakeholders. Protect project scope through effective change management and ensure that all delivered environments are supported by clear documentation, runbooks, and knowledge transfer. Apply AI-assisted development tools thoughtfully in architecture, implementation, troubleshooting, and delivery workflows while maintaining strong technical judgment and quality standards. Requirements 5+ years of hands-on cloud infrastructure and architecture experience, with deep production experience specifically in Google Cloud. Strong expertise in Terraform, including reusable and modular infrastructure code, remote state management, and importing manually provisioned environments. Proven production experience with Kubernetes and GKE, including private clusters, node pools, autoscaling, RBAC, Workload Identity, Helm, and ingress. Strong knowledge of Google Cloud networking and security, including VPC architecture, Cloud NAT, DNS, VPN, Private Service Connect, firewall policies, IAM, Organization Policies, and Secret Manager. Practical experience with CI/CD and DevOps practices, including GitHub Actions or equivalent, keyless authentication to Google Cloud, container workflows, and GitOps with Argo CD or similar tools. Working knowledge of AWS or Azure, with the ability to understand and assess source-cloud environments as part of migration projects. Strong customer-facing English communication skills, with confidence leading technical workshops, weekly meetings, presentations, and handovers. Demonstrated ability to manage multiple technical engagements, work within defined budgets and scopes, and take ownership of delivery outcomes. jobgether-jobgether:lever:cd216d0b-30bd-.title: Meta Ads Consultant
jobgether-jobgether:lever:cd216d0b-30bd-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Meta Ads Consultant based in United Kingdom. As a Meta Ads Consultant, you’ll take ownership of paid social growth across Facebook and Instagram, helping scale acquisition in key European markets. You’ll shape the strategy from the ground up while remaining deeply involved in campaign execution and optimisation. This is a hands-on opportunity for someone who enjoys combining strategic thinking with data-driven decision-making. You’ll work closely with senior marketing stakeholders in a small, agile, international environment. Your work will directly influence lead generation, brand awareness, customer acquisition, and return on advertising spend. The role offers significant autonomy and the opportunity to make a measurable impact within a fast-growing business. It is particularly well suited to an entrepreneurial marketer who prefers action, experimentation, and continuous improvement. Develop and implement a full-funnel Meta advertising strategy tailored to key European markets and target audiences. Plan, launch, manage, monitor, and continuously optimise Facebook and Instagram campaigns focused on lead generation, awareness, and acquisition. Analyse campaign performance, identify trends and opportunities, and translate data into actionable optimisation initiatives. Own paid social performance and continuously improve efficiency, ROI, and overall campaign impact. Collaborate closely with senior product and marketing stakeholders to align paid social activity with broader growth objectives. Advise on and contribute to ad copy, creative concepts, visuals, and landing pages to maximise campaign performance. Prepare clear, insightful performance reports with practical recommendations for future improvements. Continuously test audiences, creatives, messaging, and campaign approaches to identify scalable growth opportunities. Requirements: Proven experience managing and scaling successful Meta advertising campaigns, ideally within startups, scale-ups, or similarly fast-paced environments. Strong expertise in Meta Ads Manager, audience targeting, campaign structure, creative testing, measurement, and performance optimisation. Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret campaign data and turn insights into concrete business actions. Hands-on mindset with the ability and willingness to move seamlessly between strategic planning and detailed campaign execution. Entrepreneurial, proactive, and results-oriented approach, with a strong bias toward action and experimentation. Comfortable working independently, taking ownership, and operating effectively within a small and agile team. Fluent English is required; Spanish, Portuguese, German, French, or other European languages are considered an advantage. Ability to work effectively within GMT to GMT+3 time zones. Benefits: Opportunity to play a key role in a fast-growing scale-up with international ambitions. Significant ownership and autonomy over Meta advertising strategy and execution. Remote working environment with a small, ambitious, and collaborative team. Freedom to experiment, innovate, and directly influence growth. Competitive consultant compensation. Opportunity to work across multiple European markets and make a measurable commercial impact. thegialliancemanagementllccompany-thegia.description: Discover the advantages of Advanced Independent Practice - Texas Digestive Disease Consultants (TDDC) - Plano - powered by GI Alliance. As a member of GI Alliance (GIA), TDDC - Plano is supported by the nation’s leading patient-focused, excellence-driven gastroenterology network that is physician-led. This partnership empowers TDDC - Plano to deliver superior, individualized patient care by leveraging GI Alliance’s robust, world-class business and organizational support, ensuring our physicians can focus on what they do best – providing top-notch care in a successful and dynamic private practice setting. ***Bilingual - English, Korean Required*** Required: Bilingual - English, Korean Start in 2027 or 2028 Practice Opportunities: Employed Position with Partnership Track Local Autonomy with National Resources Generous Financial Package Relocation Allowance, Signing Bonus & Annual CME Great Work/Life Balance Lifestyle: No state income tax Highly desirable area with top-rated public & private schools Casual to fine dining, brewpubs & shopping Walking trails, golf, tennis, soccer, cycling & more Practice Model: Light call covering only patients of the practice No unassigned ER call Hospitalist rotation every 4 weeks until established, then every 9 weeks Office hours are 8:30- 4, Scoping is 8:00-4:00 Scope at our own endo centers - Texas Endoscopy East and West locations for outpatient scopes 4 weeks per year to use for PTO or CME Replacement position for retiring physician General GI #LI-JC1 Patients Come First. Every decision we make is anchored in strengthening patient care. Our physicians lead with a commitment to quality, access, and outcomes, and our shared infrastructure ensures they have the tools, data, and support to continually elevate care in every community we serve. A Physician-Led Organization at Every Level. Our model is built on physician leadership. Through our Physician Executive Committee, Regional Clinical Governance Boards, and Local Head Physicians, clinical decision-making remains with those who deliver care. This physician-led structure, supported by national-scale resources, preserves autonomy while strengthening specialty excellence. True Partnership That Enables Physicians to Focus on Patients. Instead of a traditional management model, we operate as a Management Services Organization (MSO). Our national infrastructure, which includes analytics, technology, revenue cycle, compliance, and operational support, reduces administrative burden so physicians can devote their time and expertise to patients. We enable, we support, and we align. We do not manage. Outcomes Matter. Our leadership is driven by the measurable value we deliver to physicians, practices, and patients. Our partnership-first approach, combined with data insights and operational strength, has fueled significant clinical, operational, and practice growth. As more top-tier physicians join our specialty-led ecosystem, we continue to expand access and raise the standard of specialty-care nationwide. Interested in learning more? We are just a click away. No pressure. Just information and a partnership built for physicians who want to lead the future of specialty care. Be empowered to make your best next career move! The Specialty Alliance is a physician-led Management Services Organization (MSO) that supports leading specialty practices with national-scale infrastructure, data, and resources. Our partnership model preserves clinical autonomy while enabling responsible growth and high-quality specialty care nationwide. To learn more about The Specialty Alliance, visit www.thespecialtyalliance.com .
